title: 第64章 搞钱第63章 九品阵法师
slug: 莫欺老年穷一天增加一个天赋点
lines: 黑风镖局，密室。
魏合从一处隐秘的暗格中，取出一截不过三寸长，色泽惨白的骨哨。
骨哨表面刻满了细密的血色纹路，散发着不祥的气息。
魏合将骨哨凑到嘴边，吹出一段无声的音节，唯有精神力能捕捉到那诡异的波动。
片刻后，骨哨的血色纹路微微一亮，一道阴冷沙哑的意念直接在他脑海中响起：“何事？”
“左护法大人。”魏合的姿态，比面对“鬼师”时还要谦卑数倍，“雷云县布防已定，李玄风入驻县衙，半月之后，是最佳时机。届时我会在城内响应，恭迎大军入城！”
那道意念沉默了片刻，冷冷道：“很好。记住，你的机会只有一次。事成之后，你便是雷云县主。”
“谢护法大人！”
魏合的呼吸瞬间变得粗重，眼中爆发出压抑不住的狂热。
“切记，这段时间，什么都不要做，千万不要让那两个家伙察觉到什么，不然的话……”
“要是前功尽弃，你应该知道我们的手段！”
意念再度于魏合的脑海之中响起。
魏合的身子微微一僵，似乎想到了某种恐怖的事情一般，连连点头。
“放心吧护法大人，这一段时间，我保证雷云县不会出现任何的问题！”
与此同时，风云镖局，偏僻小院。
盘膝而坐的陈安，缓缓睁开了眼。
他内视己身。
五脏六腑在海量丹药的淬炼下，已坚韧如琉璃，散发着淡淡宝光，但距离那八品之境，始终隔着一层膜。
而他所有的丹药，已消耗殆尽。
“靠自己修炼，至少一个月，等不起。”
陈安的目光，穿透墙壁，望向了沉寂的雷云县城。
“没钱了啊，穷文富武，没有钱想要让武道走得更远，可不是那么容易的事情！”
“尤其是现在……”
陈安说着，不由得陷入了沉思之中。
现在必须得想办法搞钱了，要是搞不到钱的话，谁知道魏合他们什么时候会开始行动。
没有足够的实力，想要在这一次的变局之中存活下来可不是那么容易的事情。
只是……如何搞钱却是成了一个问题。
“想要快速的累计财富，自然是依靠着掠夺，而掠夺……”
陈安说着，不由得想到了之前秃鹫榜的藏宝库，那里的财富，甚至比起王铁这些风云镖局的总镖头加起来还要多。
秃鹫帮的财富，让他尝到了甜头。
这座城里，靠吸食人血为生的烂疮，可不止一个。
子时。
陈安的身躯内，发出一阵炒豆般的噼啪脆响。
他的身形在肉眼可见的变化中拔高，骨骼拉伸，肌肉虬结，原本六旬老者的面容变得轮廓分明，眼神阴鸷，化作一个身高八尺的魁梧壮汉。
披上黑袍，他如一缕没有重量的青烟，悄无声息地翻出了镖局高墙。
第一站，城南，黑蛇帮。
此帮盘踞赌场，放印子钱，逼良为娼，帮主毒蛇不过初入九品练皮之境，帮众数十人，在陈安眼中，与待宰的肥羊无异。
黑蛇帮总舵是一座三进的大宅，门口两名守卫正靠着石狮子打盹。
陈安的身影如鬼魅般掠过。
他的指尖并拢如刀，在两人喉间轻轻一抹。
content_en:
Black Wind Escort Agency, secret room.
Wei He took out a bone whistle that was no more than three inches long and pale in color from a secret compartment.
The surface of the bone whistle was engraved with fine bloody lines, exuding an ominous aura.
Wei He brought the bone whistle to his mouth and blew out a silent syllable. Only his mental power could capture the strange fluctuations.
After a moment, the blood-colored lines on the bone whistle lit up slightly, and a cold and hoarse thought sounded directly in his mind: "What's the matter?"
"Lord Protector Zuo." Wei He's posture was several times more humble than when he faced the "ghost master". "Leiyun County has been deployed. Li Xuanfeng is stationed in the county government office. Half a month later will be the best time. I will respond in the city at that time and welcome the army into the city!"
The thought was silent for a moment and said coldly: "Very good. Remember, you only have one chance. Once the matter is accomplished, you will be the Lord of Leiyun County."
"Thank you Lord Protector!"
Wei He's breathing suddenly became heavy, and uncontrollable fanaticism burst out in his eyes.
"Remember, don't do anything during this period, and don't let those two guys notice anything, otherwise..."
"If all our efforts are in vain, you should know our methods!"
The idea sounded in Wei He's mind again.
Wei He's body froze slightly, as if he thought of something terrible, he nodded repeatedly.
"Don't worry, Lord Protector, I guarantee that there won't be any problems in Leiyun County during this period of time!"
…
At the same time, Fengyun Escort Bureau, a remote courtyard.
Chen An, who was sitting cross-legged, slowly opened his eyes.
He looks within himself.
The internal organs have been tempered by a large amount of elixirs, and have become as tough as glass, exuding a faint precious light, but there is always a layer of film between them and the eighth-level realm.
And all his elixirs have been exhausted.
"You can practice on your own for at least a month. I can't afford to wait."
Chen An's eyes penetrated the wall and looked at the silent Leiyun County.
"We have no money. We are poor in culture but rich in martial arts. It is not easy to advance martial arts further without money!"
"Especially now..."
Chen An said, unable to help but fall into deep thought.
Now we have to find a way to get money. If we can't get the money, who knows when Wei He and the others will start taking action.
Without enough strength, it is not easy to survive this change.
But...how to make money has become a problem.
"If you want to accumulate wealth quickly, you naturally rely on plunder, and plunder..."
As Chen An said this, he couldn't help but think of the treasure house of the Vulture List. The wealth there was even greater than that of Wang Tie and other general escorts of the Fengyun Escort Bureau combined.
The wealth of the Vulture Gang gave him a taste of the sweetness.
There are more than one sores in this city who feed on human blood.
Zishi.
Chen An's body made a crackling sound like fried beans.
His figure grew taller through changes visible to the naked eye, his bones stretched and his muscles knitted. The face of a sixty-year-old man became chiseled and his eyes were sinister, transforming into a burly man eight feet tall.
Putting on his black robe, he climbed out of the high wall of the escort agency quietly like a wisp of weightless smoke.
First stop, south of the city, Black Snake Gang.
This gang occupies the casino, makes loan sharks, and forces girls into prostitution. The leader of the gang is just a poisonous snake who has just entered the realm of ninth-level skin training. The dozens of people in the gang are no different from fat sheep waiting to be slaughtered in Chen An's eyes.
The head of the Black Snake Gang is a mansion with three entrances. Two guards at the door are taking a nap against stone lions.
Chen An's figure passed by like a ghost.
His fingertips were brought together like knives, and he lightly touched their throats.
